part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change what is measured: instead of skill-at-N, estimate the infinite-member skill S_inf and the convergence exponent per case by extrapolation across nested subsamples, plus a date-bootstrap confidence interval on the 50-to-1,000 gain.","reason":"Measures new quantities—infinite-member asymptote, convergence exponent, resolvability—instead of repeatedly scoring skill-at-N ladder levels."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the unit of work: estimate the predictive distribution per gridpoint-lead from about 100 members (parametric tail fit - Gaussian body plus generalized Pareto tail - or quantile interpolation on sorted members), then draw arbitrarily many virtual members on CPU.","reason":"Replaces GPU rollouts with distribution fitting, so cheap CPU compute buys arbitrarily many members it could not before."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the objective and comparison: hold total members fixed and vary the number of distinct model distributions they are drawn from - 150 members as 150xAIFS-ENS versus a pool of 50 AIFS-ENS + 50 GraphCast-family + 50 SFNO/HENS-family.","reason":"Redirects compute from more draws to model-family diversity, buying decorrelated errors that member count cannot provide."}]}
